Vacuum Jug Eagle Company – Insulated Hot &amp; Cold Glass Carafe in Red (1.5 L &amp; 2 L)
Description:Enjoy perfectly hot or refreshingly cool beverages for hours with the Original Eagle Vacuum Jug, crafted by Eagle Company. Its double‑wall vacuum insulation and durable glass liner lock in temperature—keeping coffee, tea, or chilled drinks at the ideal warmth or chill whether you’re at home, in the office, or entertaining guests. The vibrant red exterior adds a pop of color to your kitchen or dining table while the ergonomic handle and drip‑free spout ensure easy, mess‑free pouring.
Designed for everyday convenience and lasting performance, this jug is available in 1.5 liter and 2 liter capacities to suit your serving needs. The secure, twist‑on lid prevents spills and helps retain heat, while the wide mouth makes filling, cleaning, and adding ice cubes effortless.
